systems.platform: web version and downloadable mobile application; anonymous or named reports
systems.owner: Brigade centrale de lutte contre la cybercriminalité (BCLCC), a directorate-general of the Ministère de la Sécurité
systems.tiers: online, for the public; in service for about a year at September 2026; 77 reports received in one week

note: Interview with a BCLCC officer on cybercrime: complaint counts (6,288 in 2025, over 1,000 in the first half of 2026) and losses for one class of offence at a central brigade. It names no system in which a station records a report or a case, and says nothing of how the brigade's own complaints are recorded.
